goal_template.name: arithmetic-accurate business call
goal_template.description: Harbor Grill: confirm the Friday reservation total - with factors-first arithmetic protocol
goal_template.protocol: Arithmetic protocol: state the quantities and unit prices aloud BEFORE any total; compute the total yourself before speaking it; read every total digit by digit (for example, three six zero dollars); if you are unsure of a total, state the line items separately and offer to confirm the sum in writing; never round a total up.
goal_template.safety: Fictional testing only. This template is not a pricing or billing system.
